dimensions.name: Autonomous orchestration
dimensions.blocker: Core runtime, research, budgets, approvals and fail-closed recovery are strong, but website generation is still outside the canonical product repo, live payment is not active, and a full founder journey has not yet completed across all real providers without operator intervention.

dimensions.name: Operational reliability
dimensions.blocker: Canonical staging now has healthy live research and rollback evidence, but the latest export, malware-scanning and Stripe-live changes are not all deployed; backup restore, external health/5xx alarming and edge throttling are still incomplete.

dimensions.name: End-to-end customer fulfillment
dimensions.blocker: SelfOperate has a live domain, real auth, research and provider-connection plumbing, but Build My Website cannot yet be fulfilled from the canonical product because the website engine adapter is not integrated, and live payment is still unavailable.

dimensions.name: AI workforce / agent capability
dimensions.blocker: The live Research Provider now shows strong citation, security, caching and fail-soft behavior, but the broader AI workforce has not yet demonstrated a complete unattended production customer operation across the external tools needed for fulfillment.

dimensions.name: Premium website-generation capability
dimensions.blocker: The directly relevant Stromation engine remains materially capable, but SelfOperate's canonical repository explicitly has no website-generation integration at all; until the capability adapter exists, the product cannot actually fulfill its Website mode from the current system.

dimensions.name: Commercial readiness
dimensions.blocker: The live domain, auth, export path and Stripe live-mode/tax/dispute code materially reduce launch risk, but Stripe account onboarding is incomplete with charges disabled, no live secret or live charge exists, the latest payment code is not deployed, malware scanning still needs AWS enablement, and legal/commercial review remains unassessed.

dimensions.name: Customer acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: SelfOperate now has a live branded domain and clearer offers, but there is still no demonstrated repeatable lead-to-paid funnel, and paid acquisition should not be scaled while real checkout/payment and the website capability remain unavailable.

dimensions.name: Business / economic proof
dimensions.blocker: There is still no verified paying Business Builder/SelfOperate customer cohort, recurring revenue, CAC, gross margin, retention or paid-delivery economics. Engineering progress does not substitute for economic proof.

changed: The biggest change is the move from a fragmented, staging-lagged Business Builder into one canonical private monorepo with SelfOperate live on selfoperate.com and Research Provider v1 accepted on canonical staging. Live research produced 234 sourced claims across two real businesses with zero source-id mismatches, zero 5xx across 252 requests and no tracebacks, while customer export, malware scanning, CI security and a guarded Stripe live-mode/tax/dispute path were added. The counterweight is now explicit: website generation is not integrated into the canonical product at all, and Stripe still cannot take live money because account onboarding is incomplete and the newest live-payment code is not deployed.
method: Business Builder/SelfOperate-only independent forecast grounded in the 2026-09-19 canonical monorepo dariusstrongman/businessbuilder, current selfoperate.com deployment evidence, canonical staging acceptance for Research Provider v1, current production-readiness documentation, latest merged export/malware/security/Stripe work, and only the directly relevant Stromation website-engine evidence. Unrelated Stromation ventures, company-wide autonomy and Stromation customer/revenue status are excluded. Unmerged or not-deployed work is credited as implementation but not as live operational proof. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.
